title: Sarasota, FL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Sarasota, FL: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Sarasota is a city in FL with a population of 58,000. Cultural hub on the Gulf Coast with Siesta Key Beach, the Ringling Museum, and opera. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews older, with a median age of 49.3.
